summary: First test run for FoodU. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (root, diet plan, chat hinglish+english+general, feed, register/login/duplicate/wrong-pw/me/profile update, admin login, logs CRUD + auth guard). Frontend: full end-to-end flow verified via Playwright — home + 3D hero + 12 feed cards render, like/bookmark/double-tap work, Food Inspector opens with macro sections and closes, Log kcal redirects to /login when logged out and logs successfully with toast when logged in, registration + login + logout + admin login all work, floating coach opens with reply + Hinglish/English toggle, Diet Plan sheet form submits and renders 5 meal blocks + BMI/BMR/TDEE/target metrics + macro cards, Stories tray items open GenZ tip modal, My Logs sheet opens with totals for authenticated user.

integration_issues.flow: Sequential sheet open after closing another sheet (logs -> diet)
integration_issues.issue: Occasionally hero-diet-btn click right after closing logs-sheet does not open diet-sheet (race with AnimatePresence exit). Works reliably in isolation and via nav-diet. Not user-blocking.

issues: THREE.Clock deprecation warning (harmless, from react-three-fiber internals)

action_items: (Optional) Add a small delay/lock or unified sheet-manager so opening a new slide-in sheet immediately after closing another is deterministic — not user-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: uses HS256 with JWT_SECRET from env, bcrypt hash format $2b$ verified — good. seed_admin correctly updates existing admin password if changed.
server.py: /api/logs uses ObjectId(log_id) without validation — malformed id would 500 (bson.errors.InvalidId). Consider try/except and 404.

CORS: allow_credentials=True with CORS_ORIGINS='*' is technically invalid per spec (browsers reject). Since frontend uses Bearer token (not cookies) this is not currently breaking, but recommend switching to explicit origin list.
nutrition.py _slot_pool: 'early morning' slot returns empty foods array if early_morning_choice keyword not in DB (silent no-food). Current data covers it, but consider fallback.
FeedCard: double-tap detection uses 300ms window and same handler as single tap — real single click also toggles the timer state; acceptable UX-wise.
Frontend api.js: JWT stored in localStorage (XSS-exposed). Acceptable for MVP but note for security review.
test_credentials: Admin: coach@foodu.app / FoodU@2026 (verified). Fresh users created dynamically via /api/auth/register with @example.com domain (avoid @foodu.test — EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs).
seed_data_creation: Registered transient users like test_<hex>@example.com and ui_<hex>@example.com; created and deleted TEST_Dal calorie log during CRUD test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_foodu_api.py — run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_foodu_api.py -v. Use @example.com for EmailStr, NOT @foodu.test (reserved TLD -> 422). Frontend REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is https://nutriflow-3d.preview.emergentagent.com. All key elements have data-testid. When testing multiple slide-in sheets sequentially, add ~500ms wait between close and next open. Coach chat is rule-based Hinglish (no LLM latency).
